call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, all the best, all the very best, bye (informal), bye (polite/plural), bye-bye, have a nice day, have a nice evening, until contact (talk soon), see you. Wrap-ups: all right, then that's all; I won't keep you; I have to run; we'll talk later. Ends: Thank you for the consultation, goodbye. / No more questions, all the best. / We agreed on Monday, all the very best. / I've noted everything, have a nice day. Not ends: The courier wished a nice day but forgot to give the receipt, what should I do? / Don't say bye so fast, I still wanted to ask about the keys. / There is half an hour left until the meeting with the doctor, so there is time to discuss everything. / I wish you a nice day, tell me whether the branch is open today.
call.speech.closing.note: verified=false: не перевірено програмою; farewells із чернетки Gemini, відібрано вручну.

console.g_basics_d.back: A few things the AI needs in order to answer calls.

console.f_language_h.back: The language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language the AI speaks to callers.

console.nl_same.back: The same as the AI's language

console.f_simlang.back: Main language for each SIM card

console.f_simlang_h.back: Only needed when a phone has a SIM from another region: calls to that SIM open in the language you pick here. Needs the phone app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_empty.back: Nothing is set: every call starts in the language chosen above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers use for you. The AI uses it when it talks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names you are called by

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English name, a nickname and so on. One per line, up to 10. The AI will understand they mean you.

console.f_key_link.back: Get your key at Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI uses to talk. Usually there is no need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three sample lines in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are picked up and dropped at once. To let the phone ring as usual, press “Make it a normal phone” on the System page or in the phone app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Lets the phone ring a little before answering, the way a person does. 0 = at once.

console.f_normal_max.back: Max. length of a normal call

console.f_normal_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Shortly before the limit the AI politely ends the conversation and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Get the AI ready while it rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI starts speaking the moment it picks up. Off: the caller waits 1–3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: callers with a hidden number get the AI, like everyone else. Off: a short “unavailable” announcement is played and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI stops and listens when the caller starts speaking. Not every phone supports this; Bageo checks by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller has finished speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: the end of a turn is decided by loudness alone.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: When the caller speaks another language, the AI switches to it.

console.f_status_h.back: A short note about the current situation, for example where a courier should leave a parcel. The AI mentions it only if it fits the subject of the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Delivery: please leave the parcel at reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a quiet room sound behind the AI's voice, so it seems as if a real person is answering.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or trying to cheat you.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI pretends to be interested and asks for details to waste the caller's time. It gives out no data and agrees to nothing. Off: the AI declines and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max.back: Max. length of such a call

console.f_stall_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Longer conversations use more of the Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as for normal calls.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in instruction is used

console.p_builtin_h.back: For the saved language, answer style and name. If you just changed them, save the settings first.

console.f_knowledge_ph.back:
e.g. Parcels: leave them at reception.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Facts callers may ask about, one per line. The AI will not invent anything that is not written here.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: enter a webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy webhook URL) or the bot token and the channel ID; one of the two is enough. For private messages enter your own ID instead of the channel ID. Chat commands: enter the bot token and the channel ID and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (Mattermost works too) or enter the bot token and the channel ID; one of the two is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then enter the bot token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify was shut down in 2025; this method replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server field empty to use ntfy.sh. A token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy its token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on the iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an app at pushover.net to get the API token. Your user key (User key) is shown on the Pushover home page.

console.hint_wecom.back: In a WeCom group: add a group bot and copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add your own bot and copy the webhook URL. If Sign is chosen in the security settings, paste the secret (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan site.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your home server (e.g. https://matrix.org), the access token of the sending account, and the ID of a room it has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which services get the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST with the fields event, title, body and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's “…” menu → Workflows → “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”, finish the steps and copy the URL you get. The old Office 365 connectors no longer work.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps and integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy its URL. A Google Workspace account is required.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → Create → Incoming: turn it on, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key as email:key. Recipient: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more email addresses for a private message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, the user name and an app password (Settings → Security) as user:password, plus the conversation token (the last part of the conversation link).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On a home network an http:// address on port 5000 helps avoid certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: You need your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the recipient empty to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or an email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Sign in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends the message to the group; an empty field sends it only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, create a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple-push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher site, with no recipient. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) and user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login is also the sender address. Use an app password if your mail service supports one.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (see Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: The page ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an applet “If Webhooks: Receive a web request” with the same event name; value1 is the title, value2 is the message text.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in grey; for Docker or access from outside the home, enter your own address.

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call the AI writes a short summary. Usually there is nothing to set up here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any service compatible with OpenAI works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses your Gemini key by default. To choose another service, select “Another service”.

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is agreed during the conversation (a delivery, an appointment), an “Add to the calendar” link appears in the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to agree on a time, the AI does not agree at once; it says it will check and reply. You then press “Accept” or “Decline” in the “To do” section on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms.back: Send an SMS to the person who called

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After your decision, the phone that took the call sends the caller an SMS (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls the caller back instead.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: an SMS to a mobile, an AI call-back to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (foreign, free and the like) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with the word “thinking” in the name. A low level gives the fastest answers.

console.ph_seen.back: Connected earlier, not on the network now

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and open the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the “Allow USB debugging?” prompt.

console.ph_offline.back: Not on the network: unplug the cable and plug it in again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection is up and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection is not set up yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off.back: The USB helper is switched off

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network instead.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones over USB cannot be set up automatically. Install the Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.usb_none.back: No phone was found on USB

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add the key so the AI can talk.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in the About you section so the AI talks more like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: There is no connected phone right now. See the “Phones” section on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel to get conversation summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: A Gemini key or another summary service is needed.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it.

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone reconnected during the conversation

console.ev_shaming_played.back: An announcement about wasting energy was played

console.ev_vm_end_hash.back: The message ended with the # key

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message time limit was reached

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller hung up while recording a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: The caller does not need a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer about how to get in touch

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer after the contact was repeated

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: The caller said the contact was wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked for a call-back

console.ev_vm_finish_auto_hangup.back: The voicemail finished and the phone was hung up

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: There was no sound from the AI, transferred to voicemail

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI's sound could not be played, transferred to voicemail

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: A call during another conversation, declined as busy

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: A recording or a voice menu: the phone was hung up

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This SMS cannot be sent again: no decision has been made about the appointment yet, or the SMS was already sent.

console.err_no_calendar.back: There is no calendar suggestion for this call.

console.err_no_audio.back: There is no recording of this kind for this call.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background sound is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The audio file for this background sound is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: Could not make the sample. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: Could not write the settings to disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: Could not carry out the task.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not know this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: The “{field}” field must start with http:// or https://.

console.err_bad_value.back: The value in the “{field}” field looks wrong.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the token or the password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service did not recognize this address or token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service answered with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo will not send data to this address. Enter the notification service's own address.

console.err_network_error.back: Could not connect to the service.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the web console at http://name.local. Latin letters, digits and hyphens only. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with the phone's camera to open the web console on it.

console.cu_local.back: This address can be opened only on this computer.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the web console address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to the home screen. Next time just press the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon on the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: For phones that do not open .local addresses (some older Android phones):

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch the mode from here

console.ph_to_ai.note: fixed: quotes the real switch label

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: The AI will no longer answer calls to this phone. It will ring like a normal phone, and someone will have to pick up. You can switch the AI mode back at any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: It is now a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers on this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: A conversation is in progress: switch after it ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: a conversation is in progress on the phone. Try after it ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still finishing the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module is not running on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU, check that Bageo Uplink is enabled and restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not change the default calling app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the call-screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change Do Not Disturb

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not turn the ringer sound back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the app on the phone is out of date. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed yet. Refresh the page in a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: an error occurred on the phone

console.pill_all_normal.back: All phones are in normal-phone mode

console.er_new.back: Give the AI an errand to call

console.er_new_d.back: The AI will call, take care of it and tell you the result. During the call you can read live captions and tell the AI what to do at any time.
console.er_new_d.note: fixed: live captions and tell the AI

console.er_to_ph.back: Enter a name to find a contact, or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: No contact by that name was found. You can also enter the number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact from the list or enter a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back:
e.g. Book a table for 4 tomorrow at 19:00 under Kovalenko, non-smoking room; if 19:00 is taken, 19:30 to 20:00 is fine
or: Ask which day this weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: Describe what needs to be done and which options suit you. If the AI has doubts during the conversation, it will ask you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your errand as your assistant.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line that can call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal-phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in normal phone mode cannot make AI calls. On the System page turn on “AI answers calls”.
console.er_phone_h.note: fixed: quotes the real switch label

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so the AI does not have to stop and ask again during the conversation.

console.er_started.back: The errand was handed to the AI. It is already calling.

console.er_queued.back: Queued. The AI will call as soon as a phone is free.

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs to be done. The AI will call, take care of it and tell you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If nobody picks up or the line is busy, it calls again every minute, up to 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Call until answered: try {n} got no answer, next call at {time}

console.er_watching.back: You are watching: if in doubt, the AI will ask you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will decide itself

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell them 8 pm works too

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI will end the conversation at once. The errand may be left unfinished.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other person

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not there, no answer

console.er_options.back: The options offered. Choose one and the AI will call back with that answer:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and have the AI call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI will call {who} again and pass on this reply.

console.er_open_call.note: fixed: not the same as the audio recording

console.er_delete_b.back: It will disappear from this list. The call records will stay.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or paid number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM card that can call this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not taken a call yet, so the system does not know which SIM cards are in it. Call it once and try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI should do.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: The text is too long: at most 1000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: No AI phone is available right now (none connected, or all are in normal-phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This AI errand or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still queued or in progress. Try after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The conversation has already ended, so the AI cannot pass this on.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Who the AI says it is when it calls on your errand. Each errand can still choose its own.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: Whitelist (family and friends; they can be put through to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Stall list (the AI wastes their time from the very start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls from this number are handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you directly, and when. This does not replace the emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Don't answer: forward to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers and puts you through if the matter is urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone calls in urgent cases.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: Once set, the web console asks for the password when opened (once per browser). Required for signing in from a phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you plan to open this web console outside your home network. You can change it at any time in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser will remember the password. On a new device it will have to be entered again.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must contain at least 8 characters.

console.g_region_d.back: Most users do not need these parameters.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In private messages you can leave it empty. Your ID: turn on Developer Mode, right-click your name → Copy user ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In private messages you can leave it empty. Your member ID: open the profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room with other people, list who may give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a room with only you and the bot, the field can stay empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Check calls, give the AI errands to call someone and manage the “To do” list right from this chat. Send “@your_bot /help” to see the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Check calls, give the AI errands to call someone and manage the “To do” list right from this chat. Send “@your_bot /help” to see the commands.

console.k_ai_errand.back: Call on an errand for the AI

console.ev_ai_errand.back: Call on an errand for the AI

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_merged.back: Urgent: you were put through to the caller

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI dropped out while calling you

console.urg_why_merge.back: Could not put you through to the caller

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not place the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_text_too_long.back: The text is too long. Shorten it.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question has already been answered, or the waiting time has passed.

console.d_del_call_b.back: Its summary, transcript and recording will be deleted forever.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All finished calls and their recordings will be deleted forever. Active conversations will stay.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait until the conversation ends before deleting.

console.ph_forget_b.back: This disconnected phone will be removed from the list. Past call records will stay.

console.err_device_online.back: Disconnect this phone first before deleting it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the conversation on this phone ends.

console.bl_mode.back: When a number from the blacklist calls:

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: A * at the end is allowed only for the blacklist, and there must be at least 3 digits before it, not counting leading zeros.

console.sms_empty_d.back: Once SMS forwarding is running, messages the phones receive will appear here.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation or press “New message”.

console.sms_no_line.back: No phone can send SMS right now.

console.sms_no_reply.back: This sender cannot be replied to.

console.sms_err_old_app.back: The app on this phone is out of date and cannot send SMS.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The app on the phone does not have permission to send SMS. Allow it on the phone.

console.sms_err_no_service.back: The phone has no network signal.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send the SMS.

console.sms_err_number.back: Check the number and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The chosen SIM card is not in the phone.

console.f_keep.back: How many days to keep records

console.f_keep_h.back: Calls and recordings, SMS, AI errands and items on the “To do” list older than this are deleted automatically.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: On: a phone connected by USB once keeps working over Wi-Fi after the cable is unplugged. Off: phones connect by USB only.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use this if a phone was lost or someone else used it.

console.repair_b.back: Phones on Wi-Fi will be disconnected. Connect each of them by USB once more to restore the link.

console.repair_done.back: Phones paired again. Connect each Wi-Fi phone by USB once.

console.g_backup_d.back: Backup files contain your keys and passwords. Keep them where only you can get them.

console.bk_dir_h.back: Leave empty to use the default folder, or enter the full path of a folder.

console.bk_keep.back: How many automatic copies to keep

console.bk_calls.back: Include call records, audio recordings and SMS

console.bk_calls_h.back: Backup files will get much bigger.

console.bk_item_numbers.back: Your own notes on numbers and scam numbers

console.bk_warn_newer_version.back: This backup was made by a newer Bageo. Some settings may not work here.

console.bk_warn_plain_settings_file.back: This is a plain settings file, so only settings will be restored.

console.bk_warn_password.back: The web console password will be changed to the password in this backup.

console.bk_dlg_note.back: Before restoring, Bageo will save the current settings to a separate file.

console.bk_done_apply.back: Restored. The previous settings were saved as {name}.

console.bk_done_restart.back: Restart Bageo for all the changes to take effect.

console.err_backup_dir_unwritable.back: Could not save to this folder. Choose another folder and enter its full path.

console.bk_err_busy.back: A backup or a restore is already running. Try after it finishes.

console.bk_err_dir_unwritable.back: Could not save to the backup folder. Choose another folder.

console.bk_err_disk_full.back: The disk is full. Free up space or choose another folder.

console.bk_err_io.back: Could not make the backup. Try again in a moment.

console.bk_err_not_backup.back: This is not a Bageo backup file. Choose another file.

console.bk_err_damaged.back: This backup file is damaged. Try another one.

console.bk_err_too_new.back: This copy was made by a newer Bageo. Install the newer version first.

console.bk_err_too_large.back: The file is over 200 MB. Use a copy that has only settings.

console.bk_err_expired.back: The wait ran out. Choose the file again.

console.bk_err_call_active.back: A conversation is in progress. Try after it ends.

console.bk_err_not_local.back: The folder can be opened only on the computer where Bageo is running.

console.bk_exp_title.back: What do you want to export?

console.bk_exp_keys_h.back: Turn it on when moving to another computer. Turn it off if you are showing your settings to someone else.

console.bk_warn_keys_kept.back: The keys, passwords and connections on this computer will stay as they are.

console.bk_warn_connections.back: Notification channels and permission to control Bageo remotely will change to what this file says.

console.bk_err_need_password.back: To download the file, open the web console on the computer with Bageo, or set a web console password first.

console.bk_err_bad_request.back: Something is wrong with the file or the request. Choose the file again and try once more.

console.bk_err_not_found.back: This backup file is no longer there. Refresh the page and choose another.

console.bk_encrypt_h.back: Protects copies on an external disk, in a cloud folder or on a network folder.

console.bk_pw_h.back: If you forget the password, these copies cannot be opened, and Bageo cannot recover them either.

console.bk_exp_enc.back: Encrypt this file with a password

console.bk_unlock_t.back: This backup is encrypted. Enter the password.

console.bk_err_backup_password_short.back: The password must contain at least 8 characters.

console.err_backup_password_short.back: The backup password must contain at least 8 characters.

console.err_backup_password_missing.back: Set a backup password before turning on encryption.

console.cu_lan.back: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi can open the web console at this address.

console.cu_lan_nopw.back: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi can use this address. Set a web console password before opening it on another device.

console.err_password_too_short.back: The password must contain at least 8 characters.

console.err_too_many_tries.back: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a minute.

console.bk_del_b.back: Once deleted, it cannot be brought back.

console.bk_del_need_password.back: To delete it, open the web console on the computer with Bageo, or set a web console password first.

console.f_wl_mode_h_direct.back: This phone does not pick up; the carrier forwards the call to your number and the AI stays silent. First switch the phone to normal-phone mode and dial **67*your_number# to turn on forward-when-busy, otherwise callers end up in voicemail.

console.f_wl_mode_h_emergency.back: The AI answers first; if the matter is urgent, it asks the caller to wait and calls you, and when you pick up it puts you through directly. If you don't answer, the AI says you will call back. Without your number you only get a notification.

console.wl_call_terms_1.back: The AI can be wrong: it may not call you about something truly urgent, or it may call you when it isn't urgent.

console.wl_call_terms_2.back: This does not replace the emergency services. If a life is at risk, the caller should call the local emergency number directly.

console.wl_call_terms_3.back: The call to you is placed from this phone's SIM card. The carrier charges at the usual rate; international calls or roaming may cost more.

console.wl_call_terms_4.back: After you are put through, the conversation is recorded according to your settings. You are responsible for following local law about warning people that the conversation is recorded.

console.wl_call_terms_5.back: The call to you may not get through. You use this feature at your own risk; Bageo and its developers are not liable for any loss.
